name: SLX I-spec B shifter pair
weight_description: Calculated pair weight: 120 g (SL-M7000-B-IL) + 127 g (SL-M7000-11-B-IR) = 247 g, using the separately manufacturer-published per-unit weights for the exact I-spec B controls. No side is doubled or borrowed from another mount.
